testes.nota: Failed twice before passing, both times on real environment gaps rather than bugs in our code: (1) jsdom has no ResizeObserver, which reka-ui's size tracking calls on mount — added a stub in src/test/setup.ts (shared infra fix, not tooltip-specific); (2) the tooltip content renders with aria-hidden="true" and is instead exposed via aria-describedby on the trigger (a valid WAI-ARIA pattern), so Testing Library's default role query — which excludes aria-hidden nodes — never found it until switched to getByRole('tooltip', { hidden: true }).
